LanguageData.IRBM_HeisenbergUncertainty.label: Permanent invisibility (Heisenberg Uncertainty)
LanguageData.IRBM_HeisenbergUncertainty.description: "Heisenberg-san wa Hakarenai!"\n\nReina Heisenberg's presence is an extreme uncertainty factor. Since she is logically prohibited from being observed, all enemies and automated defense systems will subconsciously ignore her existence. As long as she doesn't actively show malice, she is a pure phantom.
